headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers in a 7-1 victory, while the Washington Nationals snapped the San Diego Padres' winning streak with a 4-2 win. The Baltimore Orioles edged the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling finish, 6-5.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with Konnor Griffin (Pittsburgh Pirates) and Bailey Ober (Minnesota Twins) being placed on the injured list. Angel Zerpa (Milwaukee Brewers) was transferred to the 60-day injured list, while Craig Kimbrel (Tampa Bay Rays) and Harrison Bader (San Francisco Giants) were placed on the 10-day injured list. Welinton Herrera (Colorado Rockies), Luis Severino (Athletics), and Pierce Johnson (Cincinnati Reds) were also placed on the injured list.

Several trades and roster movements took place, including the Detroit Tigers trading Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for Juanmi Vasquez. The Washington Nationals acquired Carson Palmquist from the Colorado Rockies for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, handing the Tigers their latest defeat. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Grant Taylor impressed on the mound with 2 scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, ending their opponent's winning streak. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 6-7 decision to the Texas Rangers in a closely contested matchup. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Orioles in 5-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a tough loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Nathan Lukes and Ernie Clement leading the Jays' offense. Gunnar Henderson and Pete Alonso also made significant contributions for the winning Orioles.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 4-2 victory over the San Diego Padres, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Impact players for the Nationals included Jackson Merrill, James Wood, Luis García Jr., and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Griffin on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Konnor Griffin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Griffin's status is now uncertain as he begins his recovery.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
